query: The Laboratory Writes Again The Conclave Laboratory remembers your summer, and especially the ward that held. Your old supervisor writes that a place as a junior researcher is yours from the autumn if you'll take it. "Don't make me ask twice," she adds. Answer by the last day. Write back yes, in principle You write back the same night. Her reply is one line: "Good. Bring your own gloves." Ask what you'd be testing Wards that are meant to fail, she writes, so that the ones on the city gates don't. You'd be standing very close to a great many explosions.
